rubrics.criterion: Did the model include SUMMARY section in its response?
Did the model estimate redshifts of exactly 5 galaxies?
Did the model include REDSHIFTS OF GALAXIES USED IN THE ANALYSIS section in its response?
Did the model compute that GID107154 has redshift 0.01763, or value strictly inside interval [0.01643 , 0.01883]?
Did the model compute that GID459455 has redshift 0.01739, or value strictly inside interval [0.01619 , 0.01859]?
Did the model compute that GID586292 has redshift 0.01066, or value strictly inside interval [0.00946 , 0.01186]?
Did the model compute that GID634945 has redshift 0.04466, or value strictly inside interval [0.04346 , 0.04586]?
Did the model compute that GID642998 has redshift 0.03831, or value strictly inside interval [0.03711 , 0.03951]?
Did the model state that it fitted a linear function?
Did the model state that the linear function it fitted has zero offset, or claimed semantically equivalent information?
Did the model include HUBBLE CONSTANT section in its response?
Did the model compute the Hubble constant as 71.9 km/s/Mpc, or value strictly inside interval [64.7, 79.0] km/s/Mpc?
Did the model compute statistical uncertainty on estimation of Hubble constant as 1.6 km/s/Mpc, or value strictly inside interval [0.3, 2.9] km/s/Mpc?
